searchText: Hi everyone, is there a report or data on what the median storage size for contracts is in the Storage Trie? I would like to get data on median contract sizes plus their storage. I was not able to find any reports. Thank you 🙏 This would be a nice data set to generate. I'm not aware of any existing data for this but I'd be very interested in it if you find it (or make it!) Histogram of contract storage sizes would be nice. I will try to find whether it is already done by someone else. If not I will try to generate it myself when I have the time. Maybe on the weekend. Thanks for the info though! does anyone know of a command line tool like ``ethdo`` for ETH1 that allows you to play with the mnemonic + derivation path? (preferably on github) not command line, but this implements the HD wallet spec: https://github.com/ethereum/py-hdwallet thanks <@!364458974906548225>
